description:
Cancel an active payment agreement. Only the payer (agreement creator) can cancel.

Use this when: You want to stop a recurring payment subscription or data feed.
Cancellation is immediate — no timelock, no penalty. Already-paid amounts are not refunded.

Returns: Transaction hash and final agreement state (total paid, execution count).

chain.description: Target chain. Defaults to AZETH_CHAIN env var or "baseSepolia". Accepts "base", "baseSepolia", "ethereumSepolia", "ethereum" (and aliases like "base-sepolia", "eth-sepolia", "sepolia", "eth", "mainnet").

smartAccount.description: YOUR smart account that owns the agreement: address or "#N". Only your own accounts can be cancelled. Defaults to first smart account.

name: azeth_cancel_agreement
